summary: Reproduced the independent review counterexample at candidate 9ee7239c734292e901b5dbd9792ce261c6ae27b9 and corrected the stale full-batch flag: late prefill OOM now leaves an empty scheduler able to retry the requeued request while preserving backpressure for a nonempty running batch and preserving the candidate's typed exception, rollback, requeue, and chunk ownership fixes.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate 9ee7239c734292e901b5dbd9792ce261c6ae27b9, the first late KVCacheOOMError requeued the sole ordinary request, but the second scheduling pass did not reach prepare_for_extend; call_count was 1 instead of 2 because the empty running batch retained batch_is_full=true.

The corrected source passed 39 tests and 12 subtests, including two-pass idle retry, nonempty-running-batch backpressure, typed allocation failure, request-slot rollback, chunk ownership, and PrefillAdder boundaries.
The consolidated patch has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: Tests were deterministic CPU control-flow tests. GPU inventory found one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), not the reported eight NVIDIA B300 TP8/DCP4 Kimi-K3 environment.

remaining_limitations: The exact Kimi-K3 TP8/DCP4 sustained hybrid-Mamba workload was not run because the required model weights and eight NVIDIA B300 GPUs were unavailable.
The tiny Llama fixture cannot exercise hybrid Mamba allocation and was not used as substitute evidence.
No GPU numerical, model-semantic, multi-rank, or CUDA-specific behavior was validated.
No native rebuild was performed because no native source changed.
